race.comment: ESCALOPECAN (5) looks the horse to beat after two solid runs this campaign, including a fourth at Newcastle when beaten just under a length after racing on speed. He now comes back from provincial company, is fourth-up, and the first-time blinkers give him a clear chance to convert that recent consistency. THE LAST ROMANOV (4) was plain at Moree, but he had excuses after striking interference near the home turn. His previous second at this track, beaten just under a length by Burning Ambition, reads well for this. NAUTICAL TWILIGHT (8) was wide throughout when fourth at Quirindi and had run second at Moree before that. Her recent profile is competitive despite the distance query. SASQUA (2) worked hard from the wide gate on resumption with a tiring eighth over 1000m at Port Macquarie. Maps well and look for a better performance.
